body:
RULE (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-25, from Engram w-8f12 test-ab36871a): before any REGISTERED --input commit run (Central cold run, registered FULL or focused), the claim holder renews the bound claim with a TTL that outlasts the run with margin. Engram's interim rule is --ttl 10800 (3 h). The holder offers no handoff of that claim until the record lands.

Why: the Merger's 70-minute registered FULL passed, but its claim lapsed during the run and was recovered at 08:05:54Z under a new fence. Engram refused the record with verification_record_refused (field: claim). Per Greg's no-rerun rule, a passed gate whose record is refused cannot simply be rerun, so this loses a whole gate.

The product fix is Engram w-97e822bbbf07 (P0): the run keeps its claim live.

Note: proxy overlap (w-f5f89e7eed42) does NOT affect registered records. Only ordinary turn credit is affected.
